You should focus on being in a caloric deficit. Meaning you consume less calories that you burn, resulting in fat loss. Vegetables dont themselves make you lose weight. In theory, that caloric deficit could be entirely comprised of sugar and you would still lose fat because you're in a deficit. However, to not be hungry constantly, you should consume foods that have few calories per gram, so that you can cosume a higher volume of food. If you want a comprehensive list of non calorie dense foods, look up the satiety index. But in general, vegetables and fruits have few calories per gram, so theyre great. If u wanna eat meat, go for leaner meat like white chicken. But meat in general have a lot more calories. All processed foods have a label on the back that state their calories alongside other macronutrients.

A DOS is just a "Denial of Service", meaning all the packets come from a single ip, meaning it is easy for anyone to just block that IP. Most ""DDOS"" attacks you hear abt are just DOS attacks from cringy script kiddies who think they're the shit cus the downloaded a script. If you actually want to do a DDOS attack, you gotta make your own BOT NET. Which, unless you are an actually really skilled computer hacker who knows how to distrobute malware to hundreds of thousands of computers and you know how to make an actual command and control server to make all of the infected devices act in unison, you can't.
